title: Convene records
invalidImport: Unrecognized records file. Choose JSON exported by QAQR or wuwa-gacha-export.
consentRead: This feature reads your selected Wuthering Waves Client.log and archived logs, extracts a Convene link, and saves fetched records locally.
consentSend: Fetching sends the player ID, server ID, pool ID, language, and temporary record_id credential to the Kuro official endpoints below. Full logs are never uploaded.
consentPrivacy: Convene links and exported JSON contain account identifiers and temporary credentials. Do not share them publicly. Use only your own account; the game determines record retention and link validity.
consentCheck: I have read and agree to this data use and confirm I am using only my own account.
consentSession: Consent applies only to the current application window. Confirm again after restarting.
consentRequired: Check the confirmation box and select Confirm and use first.
subtitle: Extract a link from Wuthering Waves logs, then view and export your records.
instructions: Open Convene → Records in the game, then extract the link and fetch records.
urlPlaceholder: Extract automatically or paste a Convene records link
urlHelp: Links expire. Reopen the in-game records page to refresh the link. Copied links can also be imported into tools such as Wuwa Tracker.
extracted: Extracted the latest Convene records link.
fetched: Fetched all pools and saved a local snapshot.
partial: Some pools failed; these results are incomplete. This result does not overwrite any existing complete local snapshot.
canceled: Fetch canceled. Previous local records were preserved.
emptyHelp: Extract a link and fetch records. Successful results are saved locally and remain available after restarting.
noRecords: All pools returned no records. Check the account and reopen in-game records. Previous local records were preserved.
retention: Statistics cover only records returned by the official API. When history is incomplete, pulls to the first 5★ and current pity may be lower bounds. Pools are analyzed separately without assuming shared pity.
name: Name
chooseFolderTitle: Choose the Wuthering Waves game or logs folder
chooseLogTitle: Choose Client.log or an archived log
invalidUrl: Use a valid Wuthering Waves Convene link containing player_id, svr_id, record_id, and resources_id.
missingPath: The game path is not configured. Choose the game folder or a log file.
noLogs: No game logs found. Choose a folder containing Client/Saved/Logs, or choose Client.log directly.
noUrl: No valid Convene link found. Open Convene → Records in the game and try again.
readFailed: Unable to read the game logs. Check file permissions and try again.
busy: Records are being fetched. Wait for completion or cancel.
requestFailed: The official API request failed. Please try again later.
expired: The official API rejected the request. The link may have expired. Reopen in-game records and extract a new link.
invalidResponse: The official API returned unrecognized record data.
timeout: The official API timed out. Check your connection and try again.
allFailed: Unable to fetch records. Check your connection or extract a new link from in-game records. Previous local records were preserved.
cacheReadFailed: The local snapshot could not be read. The original file was preserved; fetch records again.
cacheSaveFailed: Records were fetched but the local snapshot could not be saved. Export JSON now to keep these results.
exportFailed: Export failed. Check destination file permissions and try again.
